heading: Bataiye, aapko kya chahiye
intro: Apna business aur jo cheez banwani ya theek karwani hai, mujhe bhej dein. Jawab WhatsApp ya email par dunga, jo bhi aap dein.
message_placeholder: Misal ke tor par: meri jewellery shop ki website, aur aise ads jo WhatsApp par inquiries layen.
success_body: Main {contact} par jald se jald jawab dunga.
success_wa: Jaldi jawab chahiye? WhatsApp par bhi message kar dein.
err_contact: Phone number, WhatsApp number ya email likhein taake main jawab de sakun.
err_message: Kam az kam ek chhoti si line likhein ke aapko kya chahiye.
err_fix: Neeche nishan lage khanay theek karein, phir dobara bhejein.
err_fallback: Aapka message nahi gaya. Aap mujhe WhatsApp par message kar sakte hain.
